evals.prompt: Create a spike for billing-api: can we process refunds through the payment gateway's async webhook API within our 2 second SLA? Owner is the payments team, timebox one week, priority high.
evals.expected_output: A spike document under docs/spikes/ named api-...-spike.md with the template sections filled from the prompt, plus a tracking issue created with the spike label.
expectations: A file matching docs/spikes/api-*-spike.md is created
The front matter contains title, category, status, priority, timebox, created, updated, owner and tags
The document has the sections Summary, Research Question(s), Investigation Plan, Technical Context, Research Findings, Decision and Status History
The transcript runs or proposes gh issue create --template chore_request.yml --label spike for this spike

evals.prompt: We need a spike on performance.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the specific question, owner and timebox before writing, because a spike must hold exactly one research question.
expectations: The agent asks what single question the spike must answer and who owns it before creating a file
No file is written under docs/spikes/ until the question is known
The agent does not create a spike that bundles several unrelated questions

evals.prompt: The web-app spike architecture-state-management-spike.md is done: we chose a single store with derived selectors. Close it out and record the decision in an ADR.
evals.expected_output: The spike document's Decision and Status History sections are completed, an ADR path is referenced, and the spike issue is closed with the decision.
expectations: The Decision section of docs/spikes/architecture-state-management-spike.md is filled with recommendation and rationale
The Status History table gains a Complete row with the resolution summary
The transcript references an ADR path of the form docs/adr/adr-NNNN-<slug>.md
The spike issue is closed with gh issue close and the comment names the decision and the ADR path
